purpose: The draggable handle of a Slider, showing hover, focus, drag and disabled feedback. It only exists inside a Slider.

notFor.case: Any standalone use; it has no value or role of its own.

Default.visual: Content/on-action fill, edge Action/primary/default (default) or Content/primary (secondary), xs shadow (shadow.xs).

Hover.visual: Edge moves to Action/primary/hover (default) or Content/secondary (secondary); shadow kept.

Focused.visual: Edge and focus Border/focus with ring Border/ring/default (default); Border/strong with Border/subtle (secondary).

Dragging.visual: Edge as Default with no shadow.

a11y.role: slider, given by the parent Slider (Radix); the thumb is presentational on its own
a11y.keyboard: One tab stop per thumb; the arrow, Page, Shift+Arrow, Home and End keys come from the Slider.
notes: Edge moves on use-hover, the focus ring on use-focus (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the edge and ring transitions (use-hover, use-focus) be dropped?
Dragging differs from Default only by the missing shadow (Figma's 4 px drag ring is not painted). Should dragging have a clearer treatment?
The xs thumb is 14 px, under the 24 px hit area. Does the Slider's track extend the hit area, or does the thumb need padding?
